displayName: DOM GET XML ATTRIBUTE BY INDEX

params.name: attribIndex
params.description: Index of the attribute (alphabetical position among the element's attributes), 1-based

params.name: attribValue
params.description: Receives the attribute's value, converted to the variable's declared type

silentCoercionDefault.condition: If attribValue's variable type is not defined, the value is returned as Text by default.

overloads.semanticRole: Gets the name and value of an XML element's attribute selected by its (alphabetical) index position.

constraints: The attribute index order is not the file's textual order: in XML, attribute index reflects alphabetical order of attribute names.
An attribIndex greater than the element's attribute count generates an error.
